note: Issue #187: who holds each place (src/systems/flow/territory.gd). The three desert outposts start with the Remnant; killing every trooper at one hands it to the locals, who move in with their own desert guards and a white assassin droid. The locals hold it for hold_s seconds of play; a supply run from Oda (j_supply on the bar board) resets that. When it runs out (or the locals' guards there are all dead) the Remnant take it back, and their troopers return. Holding all three at once drives the Remnant off the planet: nothing is retaken after that and the locals take the town's barracks too. The barracks also go to the locals when the story is done (the fleet beaten). 'posts': which soldier profile the locals put on each post (outposts: the location's guard points; barracks: the town's trooper markers; a post left out stays empty).

gate.note: While the Remnant hold the gate, each outpost they have lost makes them edgier: from strict_from lost outposts the checkpoint band is one worse, and every lost outpost raises bribes by bribe_per_lost (0.5 = +50%).
